name: Hamming Radius / Log Size Ratio
details: For every finite binary class, its Hamming radius is at least its Log Size Ratio.
proof: Let $B=\mathrm B(\mathcal H)$ on an $n$-point domain and choose an enclosing Hamming ball of radius $B$. It contains at most $\sum_{i=0}^B\binom ni\leq(n+1)^B$ labelings. Hence $B\geq\log(|\mathcal H|)/\log(n+1)\geq\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)=\mathrm{LSR}(\mathcal H)$; the singleton case follows from the zero convention.
